title: 49ers’ Kyle Juszczyk completes miraculous one-week recovery from brutal knee injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers’ Kyle Juszczyk completes miraculous one-week recovery from brutal knee injury
sources.description: At first glance, Juszczyk's injury looked to possibly be a season-ender. In the end, the 49ers only missed the 10-time Pro Bowler for one game.
